paper_id: Li et al. - 2008 - Nonthreshold-Based Event Detection for 3D Environment Monitoring in Sensor Networks
title: Nonthreshold-Based Event Detection for 3D Environment Monitoring in Sensor Networks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
motivation: 矿井监控中复杂事件(如瓦斯泄漏、水渗)无法用阈值检测,需要时空模式匹配而非单点阈值比较
problem_framing: 将事件检测形式化为在3D梯度数据图上进行数据模式匹配,而非逐节点阈值判定
key_insight: 用正交多面体(OP)建模立方体簇,配合线性回归模型实现网内聚合,兼顾压缩率与精度
method_signature: 3D梯度数据图+空间OP模型+多路径路由+增量更新机制
evaluation_criteria: 事件检测召回率/精确率、网络流量开销、对链路丢包的鲁棒性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 随机部署下召回率大幅下降至70%;简单均值聚合最高仅78%召回;SAT方法在丢包网络中几乎失效
evidence_for_taste: threshold-based approaches work well for detecting simple events
average value-based aggregation does not integrate the volume factor
the SAT approach introduces the least traffic overhead but provides the worst
exploits the stabilization of monitored environment where events rarely happen
SAT approach leads to unacceptable detection recall rate
thinking_moves: 将事件检测从逐点阈值比较重新框架为全局数据模式匹配
从2D等高线图扩展到3D空间正交多面体表示
利用几何运算(O(n))实现网内高效聚合
通过历史数据稳定性减少不必要通信开销
